scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check:api-generated: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen || { echo '::error::Failed to generate API clients from lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml.' >&2; exit 1; }; if ! git diff --quiet -- lib/api-zod/src/generated lib/api-client-react/src/generated; then echo '::error::Generated API client drift: checked-in clients differ from lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml.' >&2; git diff --stat -- lib/api-zod/src/generated lib/api-client-react/src/generated; exit 1; fi; if test -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- lib/api-zod/src/generated lib/api-client-react/src/generated)"; then echo '::error::Generated API client drift: code generation created untracked client files.' >&2; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- lib/api-zod/src/generated lib/api-client-react/src/generated; exit 1; fi
